bug: Port B lane 2 cannot write the final RAM entry in the non-collision path.
trigger: Port B is enabled with lane-2 byte enable set, its registered address is LINES-1, and the operation does not enter the same-address dual-enable collision path; for the default depth, this is address 8191 with port A disabled or targeting another address.
effect: Bits [23:16] at the final entry remain unchanged, while other enabled lanes can still be written.
